manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Take hold of the brown bottle and the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom at once.

Task description: Targets are the brown bottle with a red cap and label on the image's left and the green plastic bottle with bottom ridges on the right. Hold both simultaneously, lift and move them into the target regions in front of the robot.

Success criteria: Both bottles are held simultaneously and clearly raised above the table. The brown bottle is in the left target area near the robot at the middle of the table, and the green bottle is in the right target area at the same front-back position. Merely gripping both, lifting them slightly, or lifting only one is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- The left gripper can approach the brown bottle and the right gripper the green bottle, using the clearance on the robot-facing side of each bottle to reduce arm crossing and contact with adjacent containers.
- Prefer a relatively straight section near the label where both pads can make full contact. Avoid the narrowed shoulder and ridges at the bottom to reduce slipping or turning during grasping.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the bottle body in the selected area. Before closing, verify that the fingers are actually on opposite sides rather than merely overlapping in view and pushing the bottle over.
- As the two bottles move toward the front-center area, keep them roughly upright and leave clearance for the other bottle and its gripper to prevent bodies colliding or grippers squeezing against each other.
- During the lift, check whether the bottle moves steadily with the gripper. If it slides down, first return it to the table for support before adjusting the grasp, avoiding release while it is suspended.
